nodes.display_name: FLY - A Google Earth Flight Sim
nodes.long_description:
# New!
🛎️ AI Concierge (Premium Add-On)

- Listen and reply in ANY language

- Act as a tour guide

- Search and take you anywhere

- So much more

# Features


👥 Multiplayer with up to 8 People


🔍 Improved Search  

🌏 Travel Through Google Street View

🔖 Bookmarks  

🌇 Dynamic and Adjustable Time of Day  

🐉New Dragon Avatars (Premium Add-On)

🌌 Unlockable Sky Boxes  

🚁 Mode 2 Drone Controls 

📻 Expanded Radio Stations  

Embark on an extraordinary journey with FLY, and redefine the way you explore our planet. Powered by Google's cutting-edge 3D Maps Tiles, FLY lets you soar through the skies and witness the world's wonders like never before. From the ground all the way to the edge of space, you can truly Fly for the first time alone or with friends.

{976640067815582}

**Global Exploration:** Fly taps into Google's vast repository of 3D tiles, offering a true-to-life representation of Earth. Traverse majestic landscapes, iconic landmarks, and hidden gems from the comfort of your home. Whether it's the towering peaks of the Himalayas, the bustling streets of Tokyo, or triumphs of human engineering like the Eiffel Tower in Paris, the world is yours to discover.
{1173106120490071}
**Unique Motion in Flight:**  Enjoy a seamless and intuitive flying experience designed for comfort first. Soar over mountains, glide through valleys, and experience the thrill of flight.

{982449550039825}
Unleash your inner adventurer with Fly – and experience the joys of Google Earth with just the power of your Quest headset.

nodes.long_description:
Embark on an extraordinary journey with Fly, and redefine the way you explore our planet. Powered by Google's cutting-edge 3D Maps Tiles, this immersive experience lets you soar through the skies and witness the world's wonders like never before. From the ground all the way to the edge of space, you can truly Fly for the first time.

Global Exploration: Fly taps into Google's vast repository of 3D tiles, offering a true-to-life representation of Earth. Traverse majestic landscapes, iconic landmarks, and hidden gems from the comfort of your home. Whether it's the towering peaks of the Himalayas, the bustling streets of Tokyo, or triumphs of human engineering like the Eiffel Tower in Paris, the world is yours to discover.

Unique Motion in Flight: Feel the rush of wind as you take flight on your drone. Utilizing our unique motion controls enjoy a seamless and intuitive flying experience. Control your speed and direction with direct body motion and altitude with the joystick. Soar over mountains, glide through valleys, and experience the thrill of flight.

Streaming Music: With Feed.fm built in you will have a selection of music at your fingertips to enjoy. From Pop hits to EDM you can pick your own soundtrack.

Unleash your inner adventurer with Fly – the ultimate virtual reality app that brings the world to your fingertips for the first time in a stand alone headset. Elevate your senses, broaden your horizons, and experience the magic of flight in a way you've never imagined.

--1.7.0--
-Introducing the AI Concierge!-
Never FLY alone again with your  new tour guide
Listens and replies in ANY language
Will search for and take you to any location on Earth
Provides information about what you are seeing and where you are located
Remembers conversation context for more accurate replies

-Multiplayer Improvements-
Multiplayer options panel now lists all players
Travel to other players easily by selecting them from the list
Street View pano dots turn orange when another player is in them making it easy to select and share their view!

--1.7.1--
Fixes for a couple of minor crashes related to AI Concierge

--1.7.2--
Fixed a rendering issue on Quest 2 headsets

--1.7.3--
AI Concierge options added for hiding the HUD button and the output text panel
AI can now be used to create bookmarks
AI is better at identifying a requested location when asking to travel to a specific place
Added links for external music services while removing Feed.FM
Now supporting Asian character sets in Destination Search results

--1.7.4--
Re-fixed a rendering issue on Quest 2 headsets

--1.7.5--
AI activation options added, including ability to disable AI marketing info
Reworked how and when microphone permissions are requested
Keyboard entry button is now more clear about function for Search, Bookmarks, Join Multiplayer

--1.7.6--
Attempted fix for a startup crash likely related to Quest platform initialization

--1.7.7--
More startup sequence fixes and additional logging added to help find why some users are crashing on startup

--1.7.8--
Additional startup sequence fixes and logging

--1.7.9--
Updated to latest version of OculusXR plugin

--1.7.10--
New error messaging for users to help us understand why there are some Meta-related crashes since recent headset updates

--1.7.11--
Improved handling of Meta system sync delays that causing start-up failures for some users

--1.7.12--
More reliability fixes for the system handshake timeout during start-up

--1.7.13--
Additional error logging and handling related to start-up issues for some users
